Sounds like this will be a perfect starting platform for introducing people to the fun of writing your own text based games. Straight forward, simple interface but with the potential to add sooo much more when the authors mind opens up to grasp new possibilities... Brilliant.

comments.author: Dylan
comments.content: Fantastic! I work in a primary school and was thinking of trying to introduce Quest to the kids to promote literacy, but was thinking it would be too complex for the kids who really need help with their writing. I have written a choose your own adventure book specifically for them, but was trying to figure out how to code one in javascript (unsuccessfully, being a bit of a newbie to programming!) This sounds like it could solve all my problems!
